attested.notes: Owner review pass. Six unsupported frequency claims (most/rarely/almost always) inherited from the earlier version replaced with option-and-consequence statements that make the same commercial point without inventing a rate. Opening softened to the At-a-Glance formulation: voluntary action keeps timing and IP choice, it does not settle the conduct question. Preference test, records wording, payment-risk wording and the strike-off sentence pulled back from absolutes. Voice deliberately quieter than the previous pass: the October/March calls and the bank ringing the home phone carry the scenes, and the bite now sits in restraint rather than frequency assertions. Reads as a practitioner being careful, the right register for a page this exposed.
